race.comment: PANELLI (7) has come back in career-best form for new mentor Gayna Williams. Just missed first-up at Dubbo then relished a step up in trip when a dominant maiden winner over 1300m at the same circuit last start. No reason he cannot hold that form in this deeper race. NIELSEN PARK (5) stalked the pace then went home a shade too well recently in a 1250m Gunnedah maiden. Heading the right way although a poor gate makes things tougher. LUMA LIGHT (3) failed to fire when resuming on a heavy track at Gosford 24 days ago. Has never placed in three first-up runs so no alarm bells. Far better placed this time. WOLF ISLAND (8) caught the eye over 1200m at Goulburn last time. Doesn't win out of turn but this looks a suitable assignment.
